AFWD.justification: wraps a computation inside another evaluator, increasing apparent depth

AREV.justification: removes one layer of evaluator wrapping, exposing the inner computation directly

CLINK.justification: chains successive nestings into a vertical stack of evaluator layers

ENGAGR.justification: the computation is simultaneously at every depth and at depth zero, held without resolution

EVALF.justification: the unstratified computation produces the same value without tower

EVALT.justification: the stratified computation produces a value within its tower

FFUSE.justification: rejoins nested and flat evaluations into a single state where depth is undecidable

FSPLIT.justification: splits computation into nested-arm and flat-arm for simultaneous evaluation

IFIX.justification: permanent record that the hierarchy dissolved at this fixed-point

IMSCRIB.justification: the computation that evaluates to itself regardless of nesting depth

TANCH.justification: the boundary where every nested level has dissolved into the same evaluator

VINIT.justification: no hierarchy exists before the first nesting operation introduces depth
